items.name: Pork chop, mashed potatoes with butter, small portion green beans
items.note: Ate half of two pictured pork chops (about one chop) and one quarter of plated beans. Assumes all potatoes eaten: one third of four label servings (520 kcal batch) plus one third of 2 tbsp butter (68 kcal), total 241 kcal. Pork provisional high-side estimate 280 kcal, 30 g protein, 17 g fat; weight unmeasured, roughly 4 oz cooked assumed. Consumed beans estimated 8 kcal. User estimates 1 tbsp butter per pork and bean pan. Assumes pans shared equally among three, then applies consumed fractions: 1/6 tbsp pork butter plus 1/12 tbsp bean butter, about 26 kcal, counting full allocation despite possible pan residue. Rounded dinner 555 kcal; macros and saturated fat approximate. Potato label basis inherited from prior photographed label calculation. Fractions refer to plated food, not entire batches.
